messages.text:
I found the problem. Your earlier refund proposal for the ceramic vase (8,990 BRL) expired before it was paid, so no refund was made. The 30-day refund deadline has also passed.

Your first request was made in time. Under (refund-policy/v2/window), a new request for the vase isn't refused as late in that case. A staff member takes the case instead. I've passed it to a person, who will take over from here. Nothing has been refunded yet.
